title: Rezoning to allow housing along Park Avenue, Bedford-Stuyvesant
summary: This zoning map amendment would change manufacturing districts along Park Avenue between Bedford Avenue and Sandford Street in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, to mixed residential and manufacturing districts and create a Special Mixed Use District. It would help enable ten new buildings of five to eleven stories with 391 housing units, 101 of them income-restricted, plus commercial space and a school for over 2,500 students. The City Council approved the change on October 8, 2026.
